functionality.rationale: Discovery expiry, duplicate handling, or interface recovery defects would hide peers or retain stale endpoints.

security.rationale: Hostile LAN datagrams must not create unbounded state or trusted peer identity.

performance.rationale: Advertisement rate, peer count, cache growth, and parser allocation must remain bounded under LAN load.

compatibility.rationale: The service must implement the accepted discovery v1 contract without changing its wire behavior.

concurrency.rationale: Interface changes, expiry timers, datagrams, and shutdown race on the engine-owned runtime.

platform.rationale: Discovery adapters and interface-change behavior differ across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

persistence.rationale: Discovery candidates are ephemeral and this task stores no durable state.

adr.rationale: The task implements accepted discovery contracts without changing them.

architecture.rationale: XT-032 owns the durable architecture update after end-to-end acceptance.

roadmap.rationale: Native discovery alone does not complete the user-visible vertical slice.
